topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got back from work to find a package on my doorstep. At first, I thought it might be something I ordered, but the name on the label doesn’t match mine. It’s for someone I’ve never heard of—must have been the person who lived here before me. I wonder how long it’s been sitting here. I’ll need to check inside and see if it’s anything urgent. Maybe I should try to contact the sender or the previous tenant. If anyone knows how to reach them, it would be the landlord. I guess I’ll give them a call tomorrow.
